reserveReview.rationale: Observed 2026-10-29: Gold Token SA's network registry identifies the exact catalog Ethereum, Base and Solana deployments and reports matched reconciliation at 2026-10-29T12:00:01.197Z, 2026-10-29T12:00:14.562Z and 2026-10-29T12:00:36.906Z respectively. Token supply equals backedWeight at each checkpoint: 1603.687, 401.159 and 407.109 fine troy ounces, with zero reported gaps. The same six serial-numbered PAMP bars (C030727, C031037, C035696, C035700, C075714 and C076016) remain live in the bar registry and sum to those same amounts, 2411.955 fine troy ounces in total, so the gold-only allocation is unchanged from the October 10 review and only the observation date moves. MKS PAMP's September 30 inventory remains the last dated refinery publication naming those bars; it corroborates bar identity at that earlier inventory date and is not re-dated here. The composition uses the issuer registry's own October 29 checkpoint throughout. MKS PAMP is the custodian and issuer parent; its inventory and the issuer registry establish no independent financial assurance or independently verified physical-vault inspection.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gold Token SA October 29 live registry matches all three catalog deployments to six allocated PAMP gold bars totalling 2411.955 fine troy ounces; separately dated MKS PAMP September 30 inventory corroborates bar identity without refreshing report dates
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All three active network entries report token supply matched to allocated PAMP bar weight with zero gaps at their October 29 reconciliation checkpoints. Independent physical-vault verification and independently audited reserve-to-liability assurance remain unestablished; the affiliated custodian's September 30 inventory is not independent assurance.
